newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Former Media Asia MD to face trial.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Former Media Asia MD to face trial.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said on Tuesday that the former managing director of magazine publisher Media Asia Pacific Ltd had been committed to stand trial on 17 charges brought by the regulator.

It said the charges against Bevan Maurice Crowley related to events shortly before he resigned from the board in September 1995. At the time, the company's share price had risen from a low of 20 cents to a high of A$1.38.
The ASC said it alleged Crowley made a false or misleading announcement to the market about the company's fiscal year profit and that he falsified invoices which increased the recorded profit.

Crowley was also committed on another charge of obtaining financial advantage by deception in connection with a loan of A$250,000 which was obtained from a bank by using false share certificates as security.
The ASC said Crowley reserved his plea to all charges.
The shares closed at 15 cents on Tuesday.
